{{short description|Dutch jurist, positivist philosopher and theologian}}
[[File:Portret van Cornelis Willem Opzoomer, RP-P-OB-59.557.jpg|thumb|Portrait of 
 Cornelis Willem Opzoomer by [[Dirk Jurriaan Sluyter]]<!-- Q37325490 -->]]
'''Cornelis Willem Opzoomer''' (20 September 1821, [[Rotterdam]] &ndash; 23 August 1892, [[Oosterbeek]]) was a Dutch jurist, [[positivism|positivist]] [[philosopher]] and [[theology|theologian]]. He was professor of philosophy at [[Utrecht University]] from 1846 to 1889.

In 1856 he became member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.dwc.knaw.nl/biografie/pmknaw/?pagetype=authorDetail&aId=PE00002167 |title=Cornelis Willem Opzoomer (1821 - 1892) |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |accessdate=30 July 2015}}</ref>
